name: VenueOps — SoftN App & Linked Forms
description: Turnkey venue hire & booking manager: space schedule with automatic time-overlap conflict detection and hourly fee calculation, spaces catalogue, setup & facilities checklists, hirer clients directory, payments & deposits ledger with HTML booking confirmations, and incidents/damage log. Includes the full-stack SoftN application (PHP + SQLite) plus 6 schema-matched FormLogic CRUD forms and charts sharing the exact same live SQLite database.
